I am an old woman here in Dodoma, and my plot is very small, just a small piece near the house where I grow a little of this and that together. I have no money to buy the chemicals from the shop, and the rains here are not reliable, so I depend on the small manure from my few chickens and goats to help the soil. My children help me when they can, but mostly it is me bending my back on this land. I save my own seeds from last season like my mother taught me, and I pull the weeds by hand because hiring people costs money I do not have.
